scenes.summary: The gate of the Originium Science Park cannot be opened as it is out of power. You must inspect three nearby generators that supply it with power.

lines.text: It won't budge... Its power is out.
According to the design plans, this gate is powered by 3 electric generators nearby. We should look around.
Since when did you get your hands on UWST blueprints?
This gate features a standard UWST architecture for frontier facilities. In fact, Endfield also constructed a few of these for them.
Some of our own facilities are built with the same designs.

scenes.summary: You successfully open the gate of the Originium Science Park. The UWST crew evacuates the site with the Collinses leading the way. You, however, must go deeper into the Park where danger lurks.

lines.text: Endfielders... I guess this hasn't been the smoothest of your journeys.
Come on, Fabian. They just eliminated the Blight and got us out safely.
Eliminated the Blight? Well, I've heard about Endfield tech, but didn't expect them to... In any case, you have my most sincere gratitude.
And thank you for the access card.
Yeah, but ... we didn't run into many survivors along the way.
Only a few successfully evacced to the sentry post... The sitch in the Park ... is probably not too pretty.
The crew mates told us that some escaped to the Infra-Station, while others were probably trapped in the underground areas.
Underground? But the breakers are down there too...
Well, we can only hope those modified devices do their job.
Staying here and praying won't do anything. Let's go.
You're heading back to the Park?
As of now, half of our people are still unaccounted for.
If they live, we guide them out. If they fall, we carry them back. The United Syndicates leaves no one behind.
No. This is our mission. You carry a far greater responsibility — we can't afford to hold you back. The fate of Valley IV ... rests in your hands.
Then we'll do our best to clear out the Landbreakers in the Park.
That will definitely help us a lot. We'll be right behind your team and search the areas you've passed through.
Try to stay on guard. The road ahead isn't easy.

options: Why don't we move as a team?

r: Why don't we move as a team?
